summary: Inogen filed an 8-K reporting completion on November 2, 2026 of its previously announced sale of its U.S. oxygen rental business to Rotech Healthcare, under an Asset Purchase Agreement dated September 29, 2026. Aggregate purchase price is estimated at up to approximately $24.8 million, based on transferred inventory and patient records, subject to post-closing reconciliation and payable in six installments. Transferred assets are specified on-rent and on-hand inventory plus related patient records. The same filing discloses a CEO transition, naming COO Andy Reding President and CEO effective October 30, 2026, and includes third-quarter results. Watch installment collection risk and residual value of retained operations.
